The Sunrise Bay nằm ở cửa sông Hàn, phía: The Sunrise Bay sits at the mouth of the Han River, west of Thuan Phuoc Bridge, spanning Hai Chau and Thanh Khe wards – right in the city center yet surrounded by the waters of Da Nang Bay. From the project it is easy to cross Thuan Phuoc Bridge to Son Tra, follow the seaside Nguyen Tat Thanh Street to Lien Chieu, or head into central Hai Chau.
